findings.title: Mismatched error IDs to nodestore data via zip(values)
findings.body: In src/sentry/replays/endpoints/project_replay_summarize_breadcrumbs.py line 118, fetch_error_details pairs IDs with data via zip(error_ids, events.values()). nodestore get_multi returns a dict keyed by node ID, and values() order is not guaranteed to match error_ids order, and missing keys shrink the dict. This misaligns titles/messages/timestamps to the wrong error IDs or drops them, causing the AI breadcrumb summary to include incorrect error context.

findings.title: Mutual-exclusion check uses truthiness, misses zero values
findings.body: In src/sentry/issues/endpoints/browser_reporting_collector.py lines 52 and 58, validate_timestamp checks if self.initial_data.get("age") and validate_age checks if self.initial_data.get("timestamp"). When the other field is 0 (falsy, e.g. timestamp 0 or age 0) the check does not trigger, so a payload containing both age and timestamp can pass validation. This violates the Working Draft vs Editor's Draft exclusivity rule and lets invalid reports through to metrics.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before feature and validation checks
findings.body: In src/sentry/preprod/api/endpoints/organization_preprod_artifact_assemble.py line 81, analytics.record for preprod_artifact.api.assemble runs before the feature flag check and before body/chunk validation. Requests that will be rejected with 404/400 and unauthenticated requests are still counted, inflating analytics and recording user_id for failed requests. The record call should occur after auth, feature, and validation succeed.

findings.title: PR comment helpers defined on wrong class, causing AttributeError
findings.body: In src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py line 406 (and same in gitlab integration), the workflow calls self.get_merged_pr_single_issue_template and self.get_environment_info. In src/sentry/integrations/source_code_management/commit_context.py those helpers are defined on CommitContextIntegration, not on PRCommentWorkflow, and get_merged_pr_single_issue_template internally calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title while _truncate_title is defined on CommitContextIntegration. At runtime this raises AttributeError, breaking suspect-issues PR comments for GitHub and GitLab.

findings.title: Flagged table visualization discards real query results
findings.body: In static/app/views/dashboards/widgetCard/chart.tsx around line 165, when organization.features includes use-table-widget-visualization the code renders TableWidgetVisualization with hardcoded columns={[]} and empty tableData data:[] meta fields:{} instead of mapping result.data, result.meta, fields, and field aliases. Enabling the flag turns every dashboard table widget blank, losing data the old StyledSimpleTableChart displayed.

findings.title: Crash when table meta is missing
findings.body: In static/app/views/dashboards/widgets/tableWidget/tableWidgetVisualization.tsx line 94, fallback columns use Object.keys(tableData?.meta.fields). Optional chaining only guards tableData, not meta, so if tableData exists but meta is undefined this throws TypeError. The component should use tableData?.meta?.fields ?? {} and similarly guard type lookup, otherwise dashboards with empty/error responses crash.

findings.title: Hook can return undefined attributes breaking callers
findings.body: In static/app/views/explore/hooks/useTraceItemAttributeKeys.tsx line 59, the hook returns attributes as isFetching ? previous : data where data from useQuery is undefined on first load or error and previous is undefined initially. Callers expect TagCollection object and do Object.keys, spread, or hasOwnProperty. Returning undefined causes TypeError. It should default to {} like the previous useApiQuery implementation did.

findings.title: Changing autofix default retroactively disables existing projects
findings.body: In src/sentry/projectoptions/defaults.py line 205 (and constants/projectoptions), default for sentry:autofix_automation_tuning changes from low to off. Project options without an explicit value inherit the new default, so existing projects that never opted out silently change from low automation to off without migration or epoch gating. This is a behavioral contract break that disables autofix broadly.
